
#Load in data
```{r}
otu_table<-read.csv("ASV_counts_lulu.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)

match_list<-read.csv("match_list_field_its.csv",header=TRUE)
```

#Find highest match to Field Community ASVs and replace ASV name with my isolate number and merge ASVs that are the same isolate 
```{r}
best_matches <- match_list %>%
  group_by(Mara_asv) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

asv_map <- setNames(best_matches$my_asv, best_matches$Mara_asv)

asvs_replaced <- names(asv_map)

#write.csv(best_matches,"best_matches.csv")

# Replace
new_rownames <- asv_map[rownames(otu_table)]
new_rownames <- ifelse(is.na(new_rownames), rownames(otu_table), new_rownames)
otu_table$new_rownames <- new_rownames

#write.csv(otu_table,"otu_total.csv")

#replace seq_with isolate ID 
otu_total<-read.csv("otu_total.csv",header=TRUE)
cluster<-read.csv("otu_cluster_column_cutoff1.csv",header=TRUE)

m <- match(otu_total$new_rownames, cluster$Original)

otu_total$new_new_rownames <- ifelse(
  is.na(m),
  otu_total$new_rownames,
  cluster$Final[m]
)

otu_total<-otu_total[,-c(1,2978)]

otu_total <- otu_total %>%
  group_by(new_new_rownames) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))

otu_total <- otu_total %>%
  group_by(new_new_rownames) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), sum))

#write.csv(otu_total,"otu_total2.csv")

# Remove ASVs that were NOT replaced
otu_filtered <- otu_table[new_rownames %in% asv_map, ]

#group asvs together
otu_final <- otu_filtered %>%
  group_by(new_rownames) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum))

#write.csv(otu_final,"otu_final.csv")

```

```{r}
otu_table <- read.csv("otu_final.csv")
otu_table_merged <- otu_table %>%
  group_by(Isolate_match) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))

#write.csv(otu_table_merged, "otu_final2.csv")

```

#Lets make cutoffs so the dataset to check field data coocurrence isn't so big
```{r}
otu_table <- read.csv("otu_total2.csv",header=TRUE,row.names=2)

#remove the first column numbers 
otu_table<-otu_table[,-1]

#get row sums for taxa
rowsums<-as.data.frame(rowSums(otu_table))
#get col sums for samples
colsums<-as.data.frame(colSums(otu_table))
min(rowsums$`rowSums(otu_table)`)

#put row sums on the otu_table and remove rows where sum is less than 7 

otu_table$rowsums<-rowsums$`rowSums(otu_table)`
otu_table2<-otu_table[otu_table$rowsums > 10,]
min(otu_table2$rowsums) #23353 rows left 

#must occur in at least 1% of 2978 taxa
otu_table2$zero_counts <- rowSums(otu_table2 == 0)

otu_table3<-otu_table2[otu_table2$zero_counts < 2948,]
max(otu_table3$zero_counts)

plot(otu_table3$zero_counts)

#write.csv(otu_table3,"otu_table_for_cooccurence.csv")
#turn the table into presence/absence
coocurrence <- read.csv("otu_table_for_cooccurence.csv",header=TRUE,row.names=1)
coocurrence2 <- as.data.frame(ifelse(coocurrence > 0, 1, 0))
#write.csv(coocurrence2,"presence_absence_otu_table_for_cooccurence.csv")
```

#Heatmap
```{r}
library(reshape)
field_matrix<-read.csv("presence_absence_otu_table_for_heatmap.csv", header=TRUE)
field_matrix<-field_matrix[,-2]
#field_matrix<-as.matrix(field_matrix)

data_melt<-melt(field_matrix)
data_melt$variable<-factor(data_melt$variable ,levels=c("X6205","X16637","X16772","X16817","X6135",
                                                  "X11659","X21710","X24048","X19488","X13515","X21153","X16520",
                                                  "X24428","X19323","X13692","X7999"))
data_melt$value<-as.factor(data_melt$value)

heatmap(as.matrix(field_matrix[,-1]), Rowv= NA, Colv=NA)

ggp <- ggplot(data_melt, aes(variable,X)) +                           
  geom_tile(aes(fill = value))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#e3e4d2","#767b48"))
ggp

field_abundance_matrix<-read.csv("otu_table_for_heatmap.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)
rel_abund_subsetance <- sweep(field_abundance_matrix, 2, colSums(field_abundance_matrix), "/")
#write.csv(rel_abund_subsetance,"relative_abundance_for_heatmap.csv")

relativefield_abundance_matrix<-read.csv("relative_abundance_for_heatmap.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)


#relativefield_abundance_matrix<-t(relativefield_abundance_matrix)
data_melt2<-melt(relativefield_abundance_matrix)

data_melt2$X2<-factor(data_melt2$X2 ,levels=c("6205","16637","16772","16817","6135",                                                 "11659","21710","24048","19488","13515","21153","16520",
                  "24428","19323","13692","7999"))
#sort into order of prevalence

ggp <- ggplot(data_melt2, aes(X2, X1)) +                           
  geom_tile(aes(fill = value))+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="#e3e4d2", mid="#ADB08D", high="#767b48", 
                       midpoint=0.5, limits=range(data_melt2$value))+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(), # Removes title
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # Removes labels/numbers
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
ggp

```

#Run NetCoMi, this step takes a long time 
```{r}
counts <- read.csv("otu_table_for_cooccurence.csv", row.names = 1, header = T)


netComi_out<- netConstruct(t(counts),
                                  filtTaxPar = list(numbSamp = 2),
                                  measure = "sparcc",
                                  measurePar = list(nlambda=20, 
                                                    rep.num=20,
                                                    quantitative = TRUE,
                                                    thresh = 0.17),
                                  normMethod = "VST", 
                                  zeroMethod = "none",
                                  sparsMethod = "none", 
                                  dissFunc = "signed",
                                  verbose = 3,
                                  seed = 123456)

netComi_out_edgelist <- as.data.frame(netComi_out$edgelist1)
netComi_out_associationMatrix <- as.data.frame(netComi_out$assoMat1)

#There is a hidden non-breaking space character that needs fixing
colnames(netComi_out_associationMatrix)[colnames(netComi_out_associationMatrix) == "Phaeosphaeriaceae\xa0"] <- "Phaeosphaeriaceae"
#write.csv(netComi_out_associationMatrix,"netComi_out_assocMatrix.txt")

#write.csv(netComi_out_edgelist,"netComi_out_edgelist.csv")

#-------------------------------
set.seed(123456)
construct_out<-netAnalyze(netComi_out,
             centrLCC=TRUE,
             clutMethod="cluster_fast_greedy",
             hubPar="eigenvector",
             weightDeg=FALSE,
             normDEG=FALSE)

summary(construct_out)

eigenvectors<-construct_out$centralities
#write.csv(eigenvectors,"eigenvectors.csv") #hubs = above 0.95
```

#Check the output from NetCoMi run 
```{r}
edge_list<-read.csv("netComi_out_edgelist.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)
net_matrix<-read.csv("netComi_out_assocMatrix.csv", header=TRUE, row.names = 1)

#cutoffs for association -0.3 and below and 0.3 and above 

edge_list2<-subset(edge_list, asso < -0.3 | asso > 0.3)

#write.csv(edge_list2,"netcomi_filtered_edgelist.csv")
edge_list2<-read.csv("netcomi_filtered_edgelist.csv", header=TRUE)

uniquelist<-unique(c(edge_list2$v1, edge_list2$v2))
uniquelist<-as.data.frame(uniquelist)

net_matrix2 = net_matrix[row.names(net_matrix) %in% uniquelist$uniquelist,]

colnames(net_matrix2)=sub("X","",colnames(net_matrix2))
net_matrix3 = net_matrix2[,colnames(net_matrix2) %in% row.names(net_matrix2)]

#write.csv(net_matrix3,"netcomi_filtered_assocMatrix.csv")
```
